title: Wogonin Inhibits Oxidative Stress in Hypoxia-Induced hCMEC/D3 Cells Through Suppressing CXCL8-Mediated TLR4/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Jin, Tianbo; Hu, Baoping; Zhang, Tianyi; Wang, Jing; Zhang, Dongfeng; Sheng, Yemeng; Wang, Li
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药活性成分汉黄芩素通过CXCL8/TLR4/NF-kB通路抑制缺氧诱导的氧化应激，属于纯细胞与信号通路实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: High-altitude cerebral edema (HACE) is a critical neurological disorder with limited treatment options. Wuwei Shaji San (WWSHS), a traditional Chinese medicine formula, demonstrates therapeutic potential for HACE, yet its mechanisms remain unclear. This study explores the molecular mechanism of WWSHS in HACE treatment. Network pharmacology was performed to identify core active ingredients and targets of WWSHS against HACE. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, functional enrichment analysis, and molecular docking were performed. Hypoxia-induced injury in hCMEC/D3 cells was used to validate wogonin's effects. Apoptosis, oxidative stress indicators (ROS, H(2)O(2), MDA, SOD, LDH), and inflammation factors (IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha) were evaluated via flow cytometry, biochemical assays, and qPCR. CXCL8 overexpression and TLR4 inhibitor (Resatorvid) were applied to investigate mechanisms. Network analysis revealed 63 shared targets between WWSHS and HACE, with CXCL8 as a central target and wogonin as the core ingredients. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding between wogonin and CXCL8 (-7.6 kcal/mol). In vitro studies revealed that wogonin effectively mitigated hypoxia-induced cytotoxic effects, apoptotic responses, and oxidative stress in hCMEC/D3 cells. The mechanistic investigation demonstrated that wogonin downregulated CXCL8 expression, consequently attenuating TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling activation. Notably, CXCL8 overexpression counteracted wogonin's cytoprotective properties against hypoxic damage. Complementary experiments showed that co-administration with resatorvid, a pharmacological TLR4 inhibitor, potentiated wogonin's therapeutic efficacy. Our findings suggest that wogonin may serve as a potential therapeutic agent for HACE by targeting CXCL8 and modulating the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway, thereby reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.
abstract_zh: 高原性脑水肿（HACE）是一种治疗选择有限的严重神经系统疾病。五味沙棘散（WWSHS）作为一种传统中药方剂，显示出对HACE的治疗潜力，但其机制尚不明确。本研究探讨了WWSHS在HACE治疗中的分子机制。通过网络药理学方法，鉴定了WWSHS对抗HACE的核心活性成分和靶点。进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络、功能富集分析和分子对接。利用hCMEC/D3细胞中的缺氧诱导损伤来验证汉黄芩素的作用。通过流式细胞术、生化检测和qPCR评估了细胞凋亡、氧化应激指标（ROS、H(2)O(2)、MDA、SOD、LDH）和炎症因子（IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α）。应用CXCL8过表达和TLR4抑制剂（Resatorvid）来研究机制。网络分析揭示了WWSHS与HACE之间的63个共享靶点，其中CXCL8为核心靶点，汉黄芩素为核心成分。分子对接确认了汉黄芩素与CXCL8之间的强结合（-7.6 kcal/mol）。体外研究表明，汉黄芩素有效缓解了hCMEC/D3细胞中缺氧诱导的细胞毒性效应、凋亡反应和氧化应激。机制研究显示，汉黄芩素下调了CXCL8表达，从而减弱了TLR4/NF-κB信号通路的激活。值得注意的是，CXCL8过表达抵消了汉黄芩素对缺氧损伤的细胞保护作用。补充实验表明，与药理学TLR4抑制剂resatorvid联合使用，增强了汉黄芩素的治疗效果。我们的发现表明，汉黄芩素可能通过靶向CXCL8并调节TLR4/NF-κB通路，从而减少炎症和氧化应激，成为HACE的潜在治疗药物。
